finding.conclusion: With the OmniHuman take as a video reference, Seedance follows the reference motion almost exactly and the prompt wording (head scale, eyes, gentler) has negligible effect. The 25 fps reference reduced seg044 hand stutter (1.4 -> 0.9) but not to r8 level. Head movement, eye expression and arm motion have to be controlled through the reference itself.
